candidates.change_summary: Remove the hasNoBalance check by deleting its modifier on airDrop so callers with existing balances can receive more tokens.
Change the added amount from 20 to 40 so airDrop increases balances by a different observable amount.
Remove reentrancy protection by deleting the locking assignment statements so reentrant calls can alter tokenBalance unexpectedly.
Make supportsToken always fail by comparing to a different string, preventing airDrop from succeeding for callers relying on Bank.supportsToken.
Invert hasNoBalance to require that the caller already has a positive balance, changing which callers can receive the airdrop.
Replace the addition of 20 with addition of 10 in airDrop(), changing tokenBalance increases.
Remove the hasNoBalance modifier from airDrop(), allowing callers with existing balances to receive the airdrop and thus changing tokenBalance observable after call.
Invert the order of locking so _locked is set to false before the function body and true after, breaking reentrancy protection and potentially changing final tokenBalance after reentrant calls.
Change supportsToken() to compare against a different literal, causing the supportsToken modifier to fail and preventing airDrop from increasing tokenBalance.
Change hasNoBalance to require that tokenBalance[msg.sender] != 0, inverting the guard so only addresses with balance can call airDrop, altering observable tokenBalance after calls.
